root_causes: Copying executable bytes over installed Mach-O inodes can leave macOS execution validation cached against overwritten code. The installed MCP exited via SIGKILL while an identical fresh-inode copy started.
The copied application bundle had invalid sealed-resource code-signing metadata.
OpenCode retained the failed MCP runtime after the executable repair; saving configuration alone did not reconnect it.

Verified staged bundle installation with installed-path checks and rollback
Metadata/executable ancestor symlinks rejected before signing
Bundled server executable/version preflight before client configuration changes
OpenCode selected-project runtime synchronization using the reviewed entry, status verification and policy-state preservation
